### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Keep agent and workspace readable with many toolchains](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3498) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — When starting a session, the agent and workspace names stay readable however many toolchains you pick: the toolchains button shows a count, with the names on hover, and the workspace picker a folder icon. An agent that can't be changed shows as its name.
